items.title: Fed Beige Book sends mixed signals: inflation proves hard to bring down, consumption splits while AI investment stays hot
items.summary: Released in the early hours of Thursday Beijing time, the Fed's August Beige Book shows the US economy still expanding modestly, but growth is increasingly reliant on a handful of projects such as AI data centers, inflation pressure remains stubborn, household stress is building, and the "K-shaped" split in consumption is becoming more pronounced
items.title_zh: 美联储褐皮书释放矛盾信号：通胀难降、消费分化，AI 投资持续火热
items.summary_zh: 北京时间周四凌晨发布的美联储 8 月褐皮书显示，美国经济仍在温和扩张，但增长日益依赖 AI 数据中心等少数项目；通胀压力依然顽固，家庭压力正在累积，消费的“K 型”分化愈发明显。
